Chapter milestones章节里程碑

Prologue route序章路线

Balstar Channel · 14

Work through both water-level states and bridge switches. The monster chest contains EP Cut 1.检查两种水位状态和桥梁机关开启的路线。魔兽宝箱内有 EP Cut 1。

Saint-Croix Forest · 9

Sweep every branch before the route closes. Cumulative target: 23.路线关闭前清理全部岔路。累计目标：23。

Grimsel Fortress · 6

Finish the fortress at 29 total before returning to Le Locle.返回雷克尔前，以累计 29 箱完成要塞。

Chapter 1 safety stop第一章保险点

Reach 65 before the orphanage segment and 84 at chapter end.孤儿院剧情前达到 65，章节结束时达到 84。
